title: Investigate production 500 error for admin chat
body: The integration tests pass with mocked MCP client. The actual 500 error reported in issue #2287 could not be reproduced. Potential causes: (1) MCP_ENABLED env var not set in production, (2) LLM API key missing, (3) /api/mcp endpoint not accessible. If the issue persists, add logging to handleAdminModeChat to capture the actual error.
rationale: The issue reports a 500 error but tests pass - suggests environmental/configuration issue rather than code bug
